lostling.name: Lostling
lostling.intro: A Lostling drifts closer, looking for something it can't name.

intro_if.text: A Lostling sees you and freezes. It has heard about you.

flavor: The Lostling hums a song with no words.
The Lostling checks its pockets. It doesn't have pockets.
Smells like a birthday nobody remembers.

reason.text: You tell the Lostling it doesn't have to be scared of you.
reason.reply: It wobbles. It wants to believe you.

joke.text: You tell a joke, then forget the punchline.
joke.reply: The Lostling forgets to be afraid for a second. That counts.

comfort.text: You hum along with it. Wordless. Together.

intimidate.text: You make yourself big and scary.

question.text: You ask who it used to belong to.
question.reply: It shows you a flicker: a kitchen, a laugh, a name it can't say.

lostling.spare_ready: The Lostling is humming happily now.
lostling.spare_text: The Lostling drifts off, humming. It seems lighter.
lostling.kill_text: The Lostling scatters into blue dust. For a moment you hear a laugh you don't recognize. Then nothing.

thornmoth.name: Thornmoth
thornmoth.intro: A Thornmoth unfolds its wings. Every scale is a tiny thorn.
flavor: The Thornmoth flutters menacingly. Mostly flutters.
The Thornmoth is circling a light that isn't there.

reason.text: You explain that fighting won't bring its garden back.

joke.reply: The Thornmoth does not laugh. It has heard that one.

comfort.text: You tell it its wings are beautiful.

intimidate.text: You stand your ground and don't flinch.
intimidate.reply: The Thornmoth respects that. A lot.

question.text: You ask where it came from.
question.reply: It was a garden once. Someone forgot to water it.

thornmoth.spare_ready: The Thornmoth bows its antennae to you.
thornmoth.spare_text: The Thornmoth flies off toward a patch of moonflowers.
thornmoth.kill_text: The Thornmoth's wings crumble like dry petals.

ink_shade.name: Ink Shade
ink_shade.intro: An Ink Shade rises from a spilled sentence.
flavor: The Ink Shade drips onto the floor and spells something rude.
The Ink Shade is trying to remember what word it was.

reason.text: You tell it the Archivist doesn't own it.

joke.text: You ask if it's feeling a little blotchy.
joke.reply: It doesn't get it. It's ink.

comfort.text: You tell it whatever it was, it mattered.
comfort.reply: A single letter forms on its face: 'O'. Like a gasp.

intimidate.text: You threaten to wipe it up.
intimidate.reply: That is its greatest fear. It fights harder.

question.text: You ask what word it used to be.
question.reply: It spells, slowly: H-O-M-E. Then smudges.

ink_shade.spare_ready: The Ink Shade is spelling 'thank you'. Badly.
ink_shade.spare_text: The Ink Shade flows into a crack in the floor, at peace.
ink_shade.kill_text: The Ink Shade splashes apart. The stain doesn't come out.

archivist.name: The Archivist
archivist.intro: The Archivist closes its book. "Ah. A new entry."

intro_if.text: The Archivist reads your page. "Not one name erased. How... unusual."
The Archivist opens a ledger heavy with names. "You've been busy erasing too."

flavor: The Archivist licks a finger and turns a page.
archivist.not_ready: The Archivist shakes its head. "I haven't finished reading you."
archivist.spare_ready: The Archivist's pen has stopped moving.

taunts: Every life is a book. Most end mid-sentence.
Your margins are full of doubt.

question.reply: "Protecting? I am CATALOGUING. Everything ends up here eventually."

comfort.text: You tell it that keeping everyone's endings must be lonely.
comfort.reply: The pages stop. Just for a moment.

reason.text: You say forgotten things deserve another chance.

joke.text: You ask if it has any overdue books.

intimidate.text: You threaten to burn the library.
intimidate.reply: "Threats are just very short stories." The pages sharpen.

phases.text: The Archivist tears out a page. Your own handwriting stares back at you.
taunts: Recognize this? You wrote it before you fell.

companion_lines.echo: Echo: "{player}, those are YOUR memories! Don't let it keep them!"
companion_lines.clockmaker: Clockmaker: "Steady now. Every page turns eventually."

question.text: You ask whose page it tore out.
question.reply: "Yours. You were FILED, {player}. Someone wanted you forgotten."

comfort.text: You tell it you won't erase it, whatever it does.

phases.text: The shelves groan. The Archivist is running out of pages.
taunts: There must be a last line...

companion_lines.echo: Echo: "It's scared too. I can feel it."

comfort.text: You ask if it would like to be remembered, instead of remembering.
comfort.reply: "...No one has ever asked to keep ME."

question.reply: "The Heart. Always the Heart." It shudders.

archivist.spare_text: The Archivist closes its book gently. It does not open it again.
archivist.kill_text: The Archivist comes apart in a storm of loose pages. They settle like snow.
